definitions.explanation: Unverified information spread from person to person.
What people say about someone or something.

{噂|うわさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{噂|うわさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まっている→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧。

notes:
{噂|うわさ} refers to unverified information passed between people. It covers both negative gossip and neutral reputation/word-of-mouth.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {噂|うわさ}を{聞|き}く: to hear a rumor
- {噂|うわさ}が{広|ひろ}まる: a rumor spreads
- {噂|うわさ}になる: to become the subject of rumors
- {噂|うわさ}をする: to gossip
- {噂|うわさ}どおり: as rumored, as people say
- {噂|うわさ}によると: according to rumors

PROVERBS:
- {噂|うわさ}をすれば{影|かげ}: Speak of the devil (lit. "gossip about someone and their shadow appears")
- {人|ひと}の{噂|うわさ}も{七十五日|しちじゅうごにち}: rumors die down after 75 days (time heals all gossip)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {評判|ひょうばん}: reputation, public opinion (more established, often about quality)
- ゴシップ: gossip (loanword, often about celebrities)
